remarks: Finally back on the market and available to shown now that the tenants have moved out!  Beautifully updated and ideally located, this spacious three-bedroom townhouse in sought-after Coachman's Square offers the perfect combination of convenience, comfort, and low-maintenance living. Just moments from downtown New Canaan, East School, parks, restaurants, shopping, and the train, this move-in-ready home places everything you love about New Canaan right at your doorstep. The thoughtfully designed floor plan features three finished levels with over 2,000 square feet of living space. The main level offers bright, inviting living and dining areas, while the updated kitchen provides both style and functionality for everyday living. Upstairs, three generously sized bedrooms offer comfortable accommodations, while the finished walk-out lower level creates flexible space for a family room, home office, gym, playroom, or guest overflow. Additional highlights include central air, an attached one-car garage, private outdoor living space, and professional management for easy ownership. Whether you're downsizing, purchasing your first home in New Canaan, or seeking a turnkey investment opportunity, this exceptional townhouse offers the lifestyle, location, and value that are increasingly difficult to find.
